<doctag><section_header_level_1><loc_11><loc_6><loc_196><loc_20>Annual imputation return</section_header_level_1>
<text><loc_11><loc_23><loc_370><loc_30>Complete for the tax year 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024, regardless of your balance date.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_33><loc_270><loc_49>43. Print the opening balance at 1 April 2023 in Box 43. This is the same as the closing balance at 31 March 2023. See the guide for further</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_49><loc_170><loc_56>details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_56><loc_170><loc_63>44. Credits - see the guide for further details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_64><loc_75><loc_71>Payments</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_74><loc_261><loc_81>RWT on interest received</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_87><loc_175><loc_94>Imputation</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_100><loc_266><loc_107>If you're a public unit trust or group investment fund and maintain a supplementary available subscribed capital account</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_110><loc_175><loc_117>(SASCA), see the guide for further details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_121><loc_186><loc_128>Other (please specify)</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_152><loc_261><loc_158>Add Boxes 44A, 44B, 44C and 44D. Print the total in Box 44E.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_158><loc_115><loc_165>This is the total credits.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_172><loc_180><loc_179>45. Debits - see the guide for further details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_182><loc_75><loc_189>Refunds</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_195><loc_60><loc_202>Imputation</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_204><loc_198><loc_211>Imputation credits attached to dividends paid.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_217><loc_284><loc_224>Other - include change of shareholding adjustment (please specify).</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_245><loc_242><loc_252>Add Boxes 45A, 45B and 45C. Print the total in Box 45D.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_254><loc_115><loc_261>This is the total debits.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_266><loc_180><loc_273>46. Closing balance at 31 March 2024</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_273><loc_285><loc_280>If Box 43 is a credit, add Box 43 and Box 44E and subtract Box 45D.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_283><loc_307><loc_289>If Box 45D is less than the total of Box 43 and Box 44E, Box 46 is a credit.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_289><loc_307><loc_296>If Box 43 is a debit, add Box 43 and Box 45D and subtract Box 44E.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_297><loc_233><loc_304>If Box 44E is less than the total of Box 43 and Box 44D, Box 46 is a debit.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_306><loc_233><loc_313>Adjustments to reduce further income tax payable.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_314><loc_244><loc_321>See the guide for further details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_323><loc_261><loc_330>Further income tax payable. Subtract Box 46A from Box 46.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_330><loc_135><loc_337>Print your answer in Box 46B.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_344><loc_245><loc_351>47. Imputation penalty tax - see the guide for further details.</text>
<text><loc_11><loc_356><loc_239><loc_363>This is the total payable and is due by 20 June 2024.</text>
